tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Aino expressing disgust, using only the supplied approved neutral as the reference for character identity, skin, hair, eyes, costume, colors, rendering and compact childlike proportions. Act the emotion with a genuinely different body pose: a restrained nose scrunch and small closed displeased mouth, a slight backward lean and one hand held away near her side. Keep the acting age-appropriate and non-suggestive. Normal pupils. Simple readable natural hands near the torso, coherent anatomy with one thumb and four fingers per hand where visible, exactly two legs and feet in an uncomplicated stance. Keep the entire silhouette including hair, accessories, hands and shoes in frame, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Transparent background, no scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or baked shadow.
